answer: Each identity anchors to a grove of sensors — temperature, humidity, pressure, light — and each epoch submits a microclimate reading, a lantern flash proving it lives in a real place. The network checks readings against weather stations and other identities: a hundred puppets in one air-conditioned room report one microclimate and collapse to one vote. Each sensor crystal carries calibration drift no clone can copy, and readings bind to a fresh nonce, so replays die. Forging N identities means planting N devices in N climates, paying rent per puppet; an honest user breathes once per epoch.
